_README: Crop-verified OCR corrections replayed onto the assembled data/zh/<unit>.txt by scripts/apply_fixes.py (string replace on the whole file). Keyed by unit id. Each fix: wrong -> right, the PDF page it was verified on, and why. Replacements may insert \n to split a paragraph the OCR merged, or '### ' to mark a heading the OCR mangled; those are reproducible where a bare re-assembly is not. See data/txt_fixes.json for the pre-assembly (per-page) fixes that must run BEFORE assembly.

ch00.wrong: 相关人们说守保密传统一一“活着烂在肚子里，死了带到棺材里。
ch00.right: 相关人们谨守保密传统——“活着烂在肚子里，死了带到棺材里”。
ch00.why: 谨->说, ——->一一, and the closing quote dropped by OCR.
二 misread as hyphen; WWII, a load-bearing number.

ch00.right:
跑进世界前列。
有谁料到

ch00.why: 有幸->有吉, 人士->人上芋.
？ dropped/misread before the closing quote position.
